correctness.rationale: Let \(M=(2^a+1)(p^b+1)=2^sR\) with \(R\) odd. Multiplicativity gives \(2^s+1\mid 2^{a+2}p^b\), hence \(2^s+1=p^c\). If \(b\) is even, \(p^b\equiv1\pmod8\) gives \(s=1\) and \(p=3\). If \(b\) is odd, LTE gives \(s=v_2(p+1)\); the cases \(c=1\) and \(c\ge2\) each contradict this valuation, so odd \(b\) is impossible. In the \(b=2\) slice, \(p=3\); factoring \(2^a+1\) and analyzing when every unitary-divisor factor is a power of two forces \(a=1\), while the branch divisible by five is excluded by the required \(2\)-\(3\)-smoothness of \(5^m+1\). Direct evaluation verifies \(18\). The bounded script is corroboration only.
